The unique swallowed row pencil is excluded; products and all intersections are then explicitly calculated. Point-incidence counts follow from the rank-one matrix count. Complete RREF enumeration at q=2,3 independently checked 20/47 admissible three-spaces, 1 four-space each, all maximal dimensions and K_(q+1,q+1) incidences, and all individual element containment counts. Finite checks are corroboration rather than proof.

value.rationale: This classifies all inclusion-maximal square-zero linear subalgebras of the first nontrivial 4x4 strict nilradical rather than only their maximum dimension. It reveals a unique larger zero-product subalgebra replacing one point of a hyperbolic-quadric ruling; the remaining spaces have exact complete-bipartite intersection geometry and q-1 nonzero-product associative types. The point incidence distinguishes central, middle-entry and generic square-zero elements and char 2 changes their multiplication commutativity. This complete natural invariant supports comparisons with preservers and more complex nilradical geometries; no artificial field cutoff or downstream theorem is assumed.
